name: Quick Mart PLC
unit: KES, printed in thousands (KES '000) and stored absolute (x1000 = whole Kenya Shillings)
scale_note: Source memorandum states all figures in KES '000; multiplied by 1000 here, the same whole-currency unit the other statement files use.
listing_status: Not listed. Offer for sale 05-30 October 2026; listing and commencement of trading 12 November 2026. No traded price, no market capitalisation, no traded P/E exist.
source: Quick Mart PLC Information Memorandum, Initial Public Offering, 02 October 2026. Historical and interim figures from the Reporting Accountants Report, 'Selected Historical Financial Information' (page marker 119 / printed 117, profit or loss; marker 121 / printed 119, financial position; marker 122 / printed 120, cash flow). Projected figures from the memorandum's own table headed 'Projected' (marker 138 / printed 136) and the front valuation box (marker 32-33 / printed 30-31). The memorandum reports KES thousands; every value here is x1000 = whole Kenya Shillings. Not listed: the company has no traded price, no market capitalisation and no traded P/E, so none is recorded in these files.
projectionNote: The columns labelled '(projected)' are the memorandum's FORECASTS (marker 138 / printed 136), covered only by an EY limited-assurance report under ISAE 3400 (markers 230-232 / printed 228-230). They are NOT reported results. The reported periods are H1 2026 (six months, unaudited) and FY2021 to FY2025 (audited).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.note: Stored negative, as printed in the memorandum (in brackets).

rows.label: Other Income
rows.note: Not a panel row. Shown because the memorandum's line it calls 'Operating Income' is Gross Profit PLUS Other Income, which is NOT operating profit; the panel's Operating Profit (EBIT) is the memorandum's lower line 'Operating profit before finance costs and tax'.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: The memorandum's printed 'Operating expenses' line (employee benefits, administration and general expenses, depreciation of property and equipment, depreciation of right-of-use assets, amortisation of intangibles, expected credit losses), stated net of Other Income so that Gross Profit plus Other Income less Operating Expenses equals Operating Profit. Stored negative as printed.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: The memorandum's line 'Operating profit before finance costs and tax'.

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: The memorandum's line 'Net finance charges'. Stored negative as printed.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: The memorandum's 'Income tax expense', printed in brackets; stored negative.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: The memorandum's 'Profit for the year/period'. Profit Before Tax plus Income Tax equals this.

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: PRO FORMA earnings per ordinary share, calculated on a post Capital Reorganisation basis assuming 4,000,000,000 Ordinary Shares; not a historical EPS on the shares that existed in each year. The memorandum states NO projected EPS for FY2026 or FY2027, so those two cells are blank, not zero.

rows.label: EBITDA
rows.note: Not a panel row. Reported EBITDA on a POST-IFRS 16 basis (operating income plus depreciation and amortisation under IFRS 16), so it is not comparable to a pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA.

rows.label: Adjusted EBITDA
rows.note: Not a panel row. An alternative performance measure, not defined under IFRS and not audited: adds back exceptional items.

identityChecks: Revenue + Cost of Sales = Gross Profit
Gross Profit + Other Income + Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT)
Operating Profit (EBIT) + Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax
Profit Before Tax + Income Tax = Net Profit
roundingNote: The memorandum's projected FY2027 column does not tie to the last digit: Profit Before Tax 3,900,106 less Income Tax 1,051,791 = 2,848,315 thousand, but the memorandum prints Profit for the year 2,848,316 thousand. The printed figure is stored unchanged; the 1 thousand (KES 1,000) difference is the memorandum's own rounding and has not been adjusted.
periodOrder: newest first; the two projected fiscal years (FY2027, FY2026) sort ahead of the interim H1 2026 and the audited years, and every projected column carries '(projected)' in its period label
